summary: fix(admin-server): resolve @fxa/accounts/oauth in the build paths
description:
Because:
- admin-server compiles fxa-shared source, and fxa-shared/oauth/scopes.ts is now a re-export of @fxa/accounts/oauth.
- tsconfig.build.json lists its @fxa paths explicitly, so the build failed with TS2307.

This commit:
- Adds the @fxa/accounts/oauth path to packages/fxa-admin-server/tsconfig.build.json.
